Definition: Perets, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Perez or Pharez = "breach"; 1) twin son with Zarah of Judah by Tamar and ancestor of two families of Judah, the Hezronites and Hamulites; from the Hezronites came the royal line of David and Christ
